title: Detailed scooter
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Rear wheel -->
  <circle cx="26" cy="78" r="11" fill="#2a2a2a"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="78" r="8" fill="#4a4a4a"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="78" r="4" fill="#888"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="78" r="2" fill="#ccc"/>
  <!-- Front wheel -->
  <circle cx="76" cy="78" r="11" fill="#2a2a2a"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="78" r="8" fill="#4a4a4a"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="78" r="4" fill="#888"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="78" r="2" fill="#ccc"/>
  <!-- Floorboard -->
  <rect x="28" y="62" width="42" height="7" rx="3" fill="#e8453c"/>
  <rect x="30" y="63" width="38" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#ff7a70"/>
  <!-- Rear body / deck -->
  <path d="M18 62 Q18 50 28 48 L42 48 Q46 48 46 52 L44 62 Z" fill="#e8453c"/>
  <path d="M20 60 Q20 52 28 50 L40 50 Q43 50 43 53 L42 60 Z" fill="#ff7a70"/>
  <!-- Seat -->
  <path d="M18 48 Q14 46 14 42 Q14 38 18 36 L44 34 Q50 34 50 40 L50 44 Q50 48 46 48 Z" fill="#3a3a3a"/>
  <path d="M18 46 Q16 44 16 42 Q16 39 19 37 L42 35 Q46 35 46 39 L46 43 Q46 46 43 46 Z" fill="#5a5a5a"/>
  <!-- Seat highlight -->
  <path d="M20 40 Q24 37 32 36 L40 35 Q43 35 42 38" fill="none" stroke="#888" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Front body / leg shield -->
  <path d="M50 48 L60 48 Q66 48 68 54 L70 62 L58 62 L56 56 Q54 52 50 52 Z" fill="#e8453c"/>
  <path d="M52 50 L60 50 Q63 50 65 54 L66 58 L60 58 L58 54 Q57 52 53 51 Z" fill="#ff7a70"/>
  <!-- Handlebar stem -->
  <rect x="62" y="30" width="5" height="18" rx="2" fill="#888"/>
  <rect x="63" y="31" width="2" height="16" fill="#bbb"/>
  <!-- Handlebar -->
  <path d="M56 30 Q62 26 68 30" fill="none" stroke="#888" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M57 29.5 Q62 26.5 67 29.5" fill="none" stroke="#bbb" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Handlebar grips -->
  <circle cx="56" cy="30" r="3.5" fill="#333"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="30" r="3.5" fill="#333"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="30" r="1.5" fill="#666"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="30" r="1.5" fill="#666"/>
  <!-- Headlight -->
  <ellipse cx="67" cy="50" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <ellipse cx="67" cy="50" rx="2.5" ry="3.5" fill="#fff8cc"/>
  <!-- Headlight glow -->
  <ellipse cx="67" cy="50" rx="6" ry="7" fill="#ffe066" opacity="0.3"/>
  <!-- Front fork -->
  <path d="M70 62 L74 68" stroke="#777" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M72 62 L74 68" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Rear fender -->
  <path d="M15 70 Q15 64 22 64 L28 64" fill="none" stroke="#e8453c" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Rear fender highlight -->
  <path d="M17 68 Q17 65 22 65 L26 65" fill="none" stroke="#ff7a70" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Front fender -->
  <path d="M68 70 Q68 66 74 66 L80 68" fill="none" stroke="#e8453c" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M69 69 Q70 67 74 67 L78 68.5" fill="none" stroke="#ff7a70" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Mirror -->
  <rect x="53" y="18" width="2" height="10" rx="1" fill="#888"/>
  <ellipse cx="54" cy="17" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#aaccff"/>
  <ellipse cx="54" cy="17" rx="2.5" ry="1.8" fill="#ddeeff"/>
  <!-- Rear light -->
  <rect x="14" y="56" width="4" height="5" rx="1" fill="#ff3333"/>
  <rect x="15" y="57" width="2" height="3" fill="#ff8888"/>
  <!-- Speed lines -->
  <line x1="8" y1="50" x2="14" y2="50" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.6"/>
  <line x1="6" y1="56" x2="12" y2="56" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.6"/>
  <line x1="10" y1="62" x2="14" y2="62" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.6"/>
</svg>
